items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: with Jimmy Garrison on base and Dick Katz on piano, and Joe Jones on drums and John Collins on guitar, just with the 8 piece group, we made that 'Further Definitions.'

ctx.x: Field, mentioned to me -- he'd like me to, you know, just use the saxophone section and recreate a couple of things that Coleman Hawkins and I had done in Paris many years earlier with the two French saxophone players, Andre Ekyan, the altoist, and Alex Combelle, who is a tenor saxophone player; so we got together, oh, Phil Woods on the other alto and Charlie Rouse on the other tenor, Coleman Hawkins, myself -- with Jimmy Garrison on base and Dick Katz on piano, and Joe Jones on drums and John Collins on guitar,…
And you did a few of the tunes of those famous brase.

items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I hadn’t met Benny Carter before then... Benny Carter took the microphone... invited Benny Carter to come and conduct a concert entirely of his music

ctx.x: Yeah I know what that is. That’s Benny Carter’s “Further Definitions.” What is that “Crazy Rhythm?”
